name: vr-control-center
description: Local VR headset management and independent playback control for Meta Quest 2

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n gateway,admin -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vrcc/admin && npm run build -w @vrcc/gateway
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @vrcc/shared-types && npm run build -w @vrcc/protocol
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @vrcc/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @vrcc/admin
